title: Curfew imposed in parts of central Paris and other cities after rioting across France
description: It comes after the country's interior minister admits that police "lost control" in some cities.

title: Watch: Clean up begins after French riots but police remain
description: Outside of Paris, Marseille saw some of the worst damage, with shop owners reporting more than 600 premises having been looted.

title: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
description: Serhii Beskrestnov says there has not been enough time to warn people about incoming missile attacks. The White House said there had been no changes to intelligence sharing.

title: Criminals detained in hospital set to lose benefits
description: The families of the victims of Nottingham killer Valdo Calocane had been campaigning for the change.

title: Burnham vows end to 'rip-off parking charges' under new rules
description: Penalties are seen as too harsh on motorists who are penalised for parking on private land.

title: Woman says she 'closed eyes and tried not to be there' during alleged Russell Brand rape
description: The 51-year-old faces three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.

title: Mission blasts off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
description: A spacecraft is set to launch on an ambitious mission to bring 10g of Martian moon dust back to Earth.

title: US church on frontline of battle against drug known as 'tranq'
description: Synthetic opioids like fentanyl are more powerful and in plentiful supply, and they have transformed the drugs landscape.

title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support, says court filing
description: The Saudi government did not immediately respond to BBC requests for comment.
